name: @repo/core
description: Pure, platform-agnostic domain core. ZERO node/react/fs/dom deps so it runs unchanged in a Cloudflare Worker (future sync coordinator), React Native (future mobile client), and the desktop renderer. `src/sync/` is the vault-sync protocol: wire types + the pure last-write-wins/conflict-copy reconcile brain. No I/O, no clock, no crypto — the caller supplies hashes + timestamps.
